cohort: The study included 13,469 patients with singleton deliveries in cephalic presentation at term at the Montreuil maternity hospital between January 2019 and January 2024, comparing 440 patients with vaginism to a control group.
finding: Vaginism was found to be an independent risk factor for cesarean section, operative delivery, OASIS, and complex tear.
mod_finding: Vaginism was found to be an independent risk factor for caesarean section and operative delivery.
